name: ESO 373-8 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 373-8, a spiral galaxy seen side-on, seen by Hubble.
label: eso3738-hubble
story: A spiral galaxy seen side-on as a thin, glittering streak, with all its contents neatly aligned in the same plane. It is one of the galaxies of the NGC 2997 group.

claims.text: ESO 373-8 is seen side-on as a thin, glittering streak with its contents aligned in the same plane
ESO 373-8 is a member of the NGC 2997 group
The ESA/Hubble image of ESO 373-8 is at RA 9 33 18.33, Dec -33 01 57.64, taken with ACS in 606 nm and 814 nm filters
